europe_now.title: Germany Blames Russia for Airport Drone Attack
europe_now.summary: Germany has officially blamed Russia for a drone incident at the Leipzig airport and responded by ordering a Russian consulate closed and announcing retaliatory sanctions.

europe_now.title: EU Imposes Health Ban on Brazilian Meat and Dairy
europe_now.summary: European Union officials have confirmed a formal ban on meat and dairy imports originating from Brazil due to ongoing health and safety concerns.

top_stories.title: German Actions Following Airport Security Breach
top_stories.summary: Berlin has attributed responsibility for a drone attack at Leipzig airport to Moscow and implemented retaliatory diplomatic and economic measures. The incident highlights heightened security and geopolitical friction across European infrastructure.
